messages:
tanvi: heads up — deploybot just flagged a regional compatibility risk: quant-v5b shows regression with runtime v2.18 in ap-southeast-1 (longseq tails). Suggest we soft-pin runtime in that region until we triage. :warning:
deploybot: ALERT: compatibility-check failed for model 'quant-v5b' against runtime '2.18' in ap-southeast-1. Suggested action: regional soft-pin. Reason: KV cache misalignment detected (rate: 5.4% error on <512 tokens).
maria: can someone paste the failing stacktrace or repro prompt? want to know if it's a model or runtime kernel issue.
tanvi: repro attached in logs. short prompts fine, but long sequence (>4k) triggers KV mismatch. looks like evict index drift. log snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T12:04:32Z] runtime-2.18 kernel: kvcache mismatch at shard 7, expected seq 4129, got 4109
[2026-03-23T12:04:32Z] model-quant-v5b: attention_state checksum mismatch
```
eli: fwiw SDK sigs look ok. I checked the sdk-3.2 client shim — nothing changed there. This smells like a kernel scheduler edge with quantized indices.
jason: if it's regional, can we route ap-southeast requests to the f32-compat variant temporarily? less ideal cost-wise but buys us time.
kevin: agree. also need a short entry in release-notes + customer comms if we keep soft-pin > 24h. can product draft a blurb?
sre-oncall: latency SLO we should watch — routing to f32 will bump 95p by ~40-60ms on average for APAC. I'll add a metric alert to watch for >2x error or >150ms 95p.
maria: triage plan: 1) soft-pin runtime in ap-southeast-1 (non-blocking global) 2) route to f32 fallback for new sessions only 3) reproduce locally with longseq harness 4) test kernel patch in ci-canary
tanvi: ok will run the soft-pin. command (deploybot):
```bash
# soft-pin runtime 2.17 for quant-v5b in ap-southeast-1
deploybot pin add --scope region --region ap-southeast-1 --target runtime:2.17 --model quant-v5b --reason "kvcache longseq mismatch" --soft
```
deploybot: Received pin request by tanvi. Verifying constraints...
deploybot: Pin applied (soft) — runtime 2.17 preferred for quant-v5b in ap-southeast-1. Will route new sessions to compatible variant for 12h.
eli: i'll spin up the longseq harness against a runtime-2.18 local build with debug kernels.
jason: i can prepare the f32 variant pool and an autoscale pre-warm if traffic spikes. ETA 30m.
kevin: leaving note for docs: add line to 2026-03-23 changelog under "known regional fallbacks" + include short customer-facing snippet: "APAC users: temporary routing to float variant for quant-v5b to maintain correctness"
sre-oncall: added temporary alert: ap-southeast-1 quant-v5b errors >1% for 5m -> pager. also watch 95p latency >150ms -> pager.
maria: quick decision: if we reproduce kernel drift, do we rollback to runtime 2.17 globally or only regionally? thoughts?
tanvi: prefer regional only for now. global rollback is heavier and affects other models. if kernel patch takes >6h, re-evaluate.
eli: initial repro shows consistent checksum mismatch in longseq harness — assigning to eng-runtime. I'll post a PR with debug trace soon.
jason: once kernel patch ready we can test in eu-canary then lift the soft-pin in apac.
kevin: i'll draft the changelog blurb and slack customer note, pinging @support to prep canned replies.
sre-oncall: FYI — set a hard expiry on the soft-pin: 24h auto-unpin if nobody extends. We can extend after we confirm patch.
tanvi: noted. thanks all — logging this as action items in the release tracker. will update thread after repro confirmation or if metrics spike. :+1:
